thread:
anya: Quick bakeoff summary: ran GPTQ/INT8/AWQ across Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B on the same calibration + eval sets. Pulling highlights now. S3: s3://redwood-inference/experiments/gptq/feb-bakeoff-2025

sam: Awesome — did you keep the same calibration size for all models?

anya: yes, 2k random tokens sampled from mix of instruction, code, and chat. seed=42. quant config mostly: gptq_bits=4, group_size=128, perchannel=true; INT8 used symmetric per-tensor where applicable.

miguel: Can you paste the core eval numbers? even rough deltas.

anya: sure, pasted quick table below (delta = quant - fp32; positive = worse):

```
Model           Eval set    FP32   GPTQ-4   AWQ-4   INT8
Llama-2-13B     MMLU       67.4   -0.6     -1.8    -2.3
                LAMBADA    50.1   -0.8     -2.5    -3.1
Mistral-7B      MMLU       61.2   -3.9     -1.0    -4.2
                LAMBADA    45.6   -4.5     -1.2    -5.0
Qwen-7B         MMLU       59.8   -6.7     -3.0    -7.4
                LAMBADA    47.0   -7.2     -3.4    -8.0
```

anya: TL;DR: GPTQ-4 is quite safe on Llama-2-13B (small deltas), AWQ-4 is surprisingly strong on Mistral-7B (much smaller loss than GPTQ), and Qwen-7B suffers under naive 4-bit GPTQ — needs different calibration / per-channel tweaks.

julia: Interesting about AWQ+Mistral. Did you try group_size sweep?

anya: yes, small sweep: group_size {32,64,128,256}. For Mistral AWQ, 64 gave best tradeoff (slightly better LAMBADA retention). For Llama GPTQ, 128 is fine. Qwen wanted 32 or even layer-adaptive group sizes to help.

sam: What about latency / deployment profiles? cost numbers?

anya: ran inference microbench on a single A100-80GB and on a T4 for smaller models. Quick notes:
- Llama GPTQ-4 on A100: 1.8x tokens/sec vs fp32, 2.4x cost improvement estimated.
- Mistral AWQ-4 on A100: 2.1x tokens/sec, best latency (smaller kernel overhead).
- Qwen GPTQ-4 on A100: 1.3x tokens/sec but had stability issues (occasional nan on kv cache) — probably quant params mismatch.

miguel: Stability issues flagged — did CI capture any stacktraces?

ci-bot: run/exp-1748349012 completed. Artifacts: s3://redwood-inference/experiments/gptq/feb-bakeoff-2025/artifacts/1748349012.zip. Logs: s3://.../logs/1748349012.txt

julia: For Qwen, maybe try AWQ or the newer GPTQ+clip adaptation? Also test per-layer outlier clipping.

anya: planned next steps: 1) AWQ sweep on Qwen-7B (group_size 32/64), 2) GPTQ with per-layer scaling and clip, 3) run larger eval suite (TruthfulQA + GSM8K subset) to check regressions. Will open PR with configs + calibration scripts.

kevin: Can you add recommended deployment mapping in the PR? e.g., Llama-2-13B -> GPTQ-4 (dedicated/pinned), Mistral-7B -> AWQ-4 (dedicated or hosted), Qwen-7B -> hold on GPTQ until AWQ sweep done.

anya: yup will add mapping + rough SLO guidance (latency/cost). Also tagging @eng-runtime to sanity-check kernel changes.

sam: thanks — this helps a lot for roadmap. :thumbsup:

miguel: +1. please include calibration sample script (we had differences last quarter).

anya: included. PR link when ready.
